title: Eastside Electric Bike, Brew & BBQ Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Not recommended for travelers with diet restrictions and allergies
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This tour isn’t just a BBQ and brewery hop, it’s a full East Nashville experience. The ride blends colorful mural art, scenic greenway trails, and historic neighborhoods with stops at some of the area’s most popular patios, beer gardens, and classic Tennessee BBQ spots.

Led by knowledgeable local guides, you’ll hear the stories behind the street art, learn how East Nashville became the city’s creative hub, and get insider insight into the small businesses that give the neighborhood its character. Our premium pedal-assist e-bikes make it easy to cover more ground comfortably, so you experience more without feeling rushed.

With small group sizes and thoughtfully timed stops, you’ll have time to relax, grab a drink, snap photos, and soak in the vibe without feeling rushed. It’s active, social, and designed for travelers who want to experience Nashville beyond Broadway.
